title: CleanGutters Lighting vs Astoria Lighting: 2026 Comparison
body_markdown:
CleanGutters Lighting and Astoria Lighting both install permanent LED roofline lighting, but they solve different problems. **Choose CleanGutters Lighting if you want one company handling gutters, gutter protection, and lighting on the same roofline** — with the person who installs your system, Alex, on the ladder personally. **Choose Astoria Lighting if lighting is the only project on your list** and you don't need a gutter partner in the mix.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting bundles permanent LED lighting with micro-mesh gutter guards and gutter repair — Astoria Lighting is lighting-only.
- CleanGutters Lighting has served South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware since 2009 with owner-installed jobs, not subcontractor crews.
- Both systems use app-controlled, color-changing LED lighting — the real split is service scope, not the fixtures.
- CleanGutters Lighting backs its micro-mesh guards with a transferable lifetime warranty; verify Astoria's coverage terms directly before you sign.
- cleangutterslighting vs astoria lighting comes down to single-trade specialist vs combined roofline contractor.


## Why this matters

Permanent roofline lighting is a roof-level install — ladders, fascia, gutter lines, electrical runs. If your gutters need attention too (and on most homes over 10 years old, they do), hiring two separate companies means two separate trucks, two separate warranties, and two chances for someone to blame the other guy when something leaks.

CleanGutters Lighting was built around that overlap. The company has worked South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware roofs since 2009, and its core product — surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards — sits on the same fascia line where permanent lighting gets mounted. Astoria Lighting, by contrast, is a lighting specialist. That distinction should drive your decision more than any spec sheet.

## At a glance

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Astoria Lighting |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Homeowners bundling lighting with gutter protection | Homeowners who only need lighting |
| Service scope | Lighting, gutter guards, gutter cleaning, gutter repair | Permanent roofline lighting only |
| Install team | Owner-installed, Alex on every job | Not specified — verify with the company |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware | Varies by market |
| Warranty | Transferable lifetime warranty on micro-mesh guards | Confirm directly — terms not published here |
| Lighting control | App-controlled, color-changing LED | App-controlled, color-changing LED (standard for the category) |
| Standout feature | Combined gutter + lighting roofline system | Single-trade lighting focus |
| Pricing model | Project quote covering scope you choose | Project quote, lighting only |

[Get a full roofline assessment from CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) before you decide who touches your fascia — the gutter condition underneath the lighting often changes the recommendation.

## CleanGutters Lighting wins on combined service scope (by a lot)

If your gutters are original to the house or you've had overflow issues, a lighting-only installer has no reason to flag it — it's not their trade. **CleanGutters Lighting evaluates the gutter line as part of the lighting install**, because the same crew handles both. That matters most on homes where the fascia board is already stressed from years of standing water or clogged runs.

This isn't a small edge. A homeowner who hires a lighting-only company and then discovers gutter rot six months later is paying for two separate service calls and possibly redoing electrical mounting points. One combined visit avoids that.

## Both use comparable LED lighting technology

App-controlled, color-changing permanent LED lighting is the standard build for this category in 2026 — that part isn't a differentiator between CleanGutters Lighting and Astoria Lighting. Neither company gains ground here on fixture type alone. **This is a genuine tie**, and the real decision sits in scope, warranty, and installer accountability instead.

## CleanGutters Lighting wins on installer accountability

CleanGutters Lighting is explicit that Alex installs every job personally — not a rotating crew of subcontractors. That matters on roofline work because lighting mounts, fascia condition, and gutter attachment points all interact. One person accountable for the whole line means fewer handoff errors.

Astoria Lighting's install model isn't detailed in public materials reviewed here — if crew consistency matters to you, ask directly before booking.

## Astoria Lighting wins on lighting-only simplicity

If your gutters are new, your fascia is solid, and you genuinely just want lighting, a specialist with no gutter conversation to have can move faster to a lighting-only quote. **Astoria Lighting is the simpler pick when lighting is the entire project**, no gutter assessment needed.

## CleanGutters Lighting wins on gutter protection depth

Micro-mesh gutter guards are CleanGutters Lighting's core product, not an add-on. The company builds around surgical stainless steel micro-mesh designed to handle heavy rain rates that overwhelm standard screens, backed by a transferable lifetime warranty that follows the house, not just the original buyer. Astoria Lighting doesn't compete in this category at all — it's simply not their trade, which is fine if you're not shopping for gutter guards in the same project.

## Pricing: two different quote structures

Neither company publishes fixed rate cards, and that's normal for roofline work — linear footage, roof pitch, home height, and electrical access all move the number. The real difference is **what's inside the quote**:

- **CleanGutters Lighting** quotes can bundle lighting with gutter guards and gutter repair in one project scope, which simplifies scheduling but means you're evaluating a combined proposal.
- **Astoria Lighting** quotes cover lighting only, which is easier to compare apples-to-apples against other lighting-only bids but leaves gutter work as a separate conversation and separate invoice.

If you want one number for the whole roofline, ask CleanGutters Lighting for a combined estimate. If you're only shopping lighting, a lighting-only quote from either company is the cleaner comparison.

Lighting and gutter protection assessed on the same visit.

**[Request a quote](https://cleangutterslighting.com/)**


## Final verdict

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if:** you're a South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware homeowner who wants lighting and gutter protection assessed together, values an owner-installed job over a subcontractor crew, and wants a transferable lifetime warranty backing the gutter side of the work.

**Choose Astoria Lighting if:** your gutters are already in good shape, lighting is the only line item you're budgeting for in 2026, and you'd rather compare lighting-only bids without a gutter conversation attached.

### Scorecard recap

| Dimension | Winner |
|---|---|
| Combined service scope | CleanGutters Lighting |
| LED lighting technology | Tie |
| Installer accountability | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Lighting-only simplicity | Astoria Lighting |
| Gutter protection depth | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Pricing transparency for lighting-only jobs | Astoria Lighting |

## FAQ


**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Astoria Lighting?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the better pick if you want lighting and gutter protection handled by one company on the same visit. Astoria Lighting is a stronger fit if lighting is your only project and your gutters don't need attention.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting install gutter guards and lighting together?**

Yes. CleanGutters Lighting bundles permanent roofline LED lighting with surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guard installation, gutter cleaning, and gutter repair in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware.

**Who installs CleanGutters Lighting projects?**

Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than assigning it to rotating subcontractor crews. That's a direct point of difference from lighting-only installers.

**Does Astoria Lighting offer gutter guards?**

No. Astoria Lighting focuses on permanent roofline lighting installation and does not compete in the gutter guard category.

**What warranty does CleanGutters Lighting offer on gutter guards?**

CleanGutters Lighting backs its micro-mesh gutter guards with a transferable lifetime warranty, meaning coverage follows the house even after a sale.

**How much does permanent roofline lighting cost in 2026?**

Pricing depends on linear footage, roof height, and electrical access, so neither CleanGutters Lighting nor Astoria Lighting publishes a flat rate. Request a project-specific quote from either company.

**What service area does CleanGutters Lighting cover?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. Confirm Astoria Lighting's coverage area directly, as it varies by market.

**Can I get gutter cleaning and lighting from the same company?**

Yes, through CleanGutters Lighting, which handles gutter cleaning, gutter repair, micro-mesh guard installation, and permanent LED lighting as one combined roofline service.


## One last thing

The detail most homeowners skip: lighting mounts attach to the same fascia board your gutters hang from. If that board is soft from years of overflow, a lighting-only installer has no reason to catch it before drilling in — it's outside their scope. That's the practical case for a combined visit, not a marketing line.

CleanGutters Lighting has worked that fascia-and-gutter overlap across more than 1,000 homes in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware since 2009. If you're weighing cleangutterslighting vs astoria lighting and your gutters haven't been inspected in a few years, get that checked before the lighting crew shows up — whichever company you choose.
